answers.question: 160/07 Q1 · In the whole-tree gate, may a test's child `aof` run a bundle built from the tree at the start of the run, instead of the source files? Measured: ~0.6 s per start vs ~2.0 s, over at least 800 child starts in the heaviest suites. A control checks the bundle answers a fixed set of commands exactly as the source does. What it gives up: a defect that shows only when Node loads the separate source files (e.g. an import cycle the bundle orders differently) would not be caught by a child-process test in the gate. In-process tests and focused runs still load the source.
